name: Web Scraper API
description: Web scraper API for Python and the command line: any page to clean Markdown, HTML or text, every URL of a site from its sitemaps, and full site crawls to Markdown for LLMs and RAG. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: scrape
commands.help: one page as Markdown, HTML or text
commands.description: One web page as clean Markdown (or HTML or text), with its title, canonical URL, language and status. Navigation, footers and cookie banners are left out by default.

inputs.name: contentMode
inputs.description: smart (whole page minus navigation and footer, the default), article (main article only) or full (entire body).

inputs.name: render
inputs.description: Run the page in a headless browser so its JavaScript executes; billed at the render rate.

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Cut the Markdown at about this many tokens, at a section boundary.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Keep only the sections of the page relevant to this question.

inputs.name: include_links
inputs.description: Also return every link on the page, de-duplicated.

inputs.name: frontmatter
inputs.description: Start the Markdown with YAML front matter (title, url, description, date).

commands.name: map
commands.help: every URL of a site, from sitemaps and links
commands.description: Every URL a site exposes, read from robots.txt, its sitemaps and the homepage links, without crawling it: the list plus the site-wide total and a count per section.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: How many URLs to return, up to 5,000 (default 100); total and summary always cover the whole site.

inputs.name: search
inputs.description: Only URLs containing this text, e.g. /blog/.

inputs.name: includeSubdomains
inputs.description: Include URLs on subdomains of the site.

inputs.name: sitemapOnly
inputs.description: Use only robots.txt and the sitemaps, skip the homepage links.

commands.name: crawl
commands.help: crawl a site into Markdown pages
commands.description: A breadth-first crawl from a start URL: every page reached is converted to Markdown, with its URL, status, title and link depth. The CLI waits for the crawl to finish.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Where the crawl starts, e.g. https://quanticdata.io/docs/.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum pages to crawl, up to 500 (default 50).

inputs.name: depth
inputs.description: How many links deep to follow from the start page, up to 10 (default 3).

inputs.name: contentMode
inputs.description: smart (default), article or full, as for scrape.

inputs.name: include
inputs.description: Only crawl URLs matching these patterns, e.g. /docs/*.
